Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
3702 North Kedvale

The Applicant seeks to rezone 3702 North Kedvale Avenue from a RS-2 Residential Single Unit
(Detached House) District to a RS-3 Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District to construct
a second story and rear addition to an existing detached house. The existing detached garage
containing two interior parking spaces will remain. The proposed detached house will have a
height of approximately 21 feet. No commercial space will be provided.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans. Pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-B,
the Applicant seeks a variation to reduce the south side setback to 0 feet, the north side setback
to 2.47 feet, and the combined setback to 2.47 feet. Pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-G, the
Applicant seeks a variation to exceed the floor area ratio imposed by the applicable regulations,
or to allow the expansion or enlargement of any permitted residential use in an RS3 district by an
amount not to exceed 15% of the floor area in existence 50 years.
